description:
Desktop AI agent with plugins, an embedded browser, workspace files, and local model support.

Lexora is a personal AI agent that evolves through hands-on work on your desktop. Beyond coding, it helps you organize research, refine creative projects, and plan everyday activities. Tell it what you want to accomplish, and it keeps working toward that goal, making words the starting point for work, creativity, and everyday life.
You can now capture ideas with voice input and listen to companion replies. Image understanding, generation, and OCR also have centralized settings, so you no longer need to keep switching conversation models to work with images.
Explore community plugins in the Plugin Marketplace to add features you enjoy. This release introduces a DSH-inspired task status bar, alongside refinements to downloads, concurrent execution, the composer, and file operations.
